scenes.audio: Upbeat, energetic electronic pop music with a steady rhythmic beat and synthesizers. No dialogue.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A series of digital art cards are floating in a 3D white void. The camera pans horizontally from right to left in a smooth motion. The central card is purple with a software interface displayed on it. Other cards feature digital paintings including a character in white robes in a traditional courtyard and a phoenix. Lighting is bright, even, and artificial with soft drop shadows beneath the cards. The color palette is vibrant against the sterile white background.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The camera continues its horizontal pan to the left, focusing on a card featuring a detailed illustration of a golden-orange phoenix with spread wings. To the right of the main image are three smaller zoom-in detail shots of the phoenix's head and wings. To the further right, another card shows a character design sheet. The lighting remains bright and consistent. The transition is a seamless continuation of the previous camera movement.

scenes.audio: The music reaches a brief crescendo and then holds a steady tempo. No dialogue.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A static shot centered on a single card against a white background. The card displays a high-resolution illustration of a golden phoenix with glowing embers, flanked by smaller cropped detail views on the right side. The colors are highly saturated with warm oranges, yellows, and reds. The lighting is soft and frontal, making the details of the feathers sharp and clear.
